title: Southward to Kujuppama Beach
description: Leaving the urban grid of Tokyo behind via coastal Route 135. Reaching the bright, secluded cove of Kujuppama in the afternoon sun, letting the sound of the surf slow everything down before an evening by the grill.

title: The Volcanic Rim and Coastal Cliffs
description: Ascending Omuroyama on the single-chair lift into open mountain air and a 360-degree rim view of Sagami Bay. Then winding along the dark volcanic cliffs and suspension bridge of Jogasaki, where raw Pacific waves crash against jagged rock.
